name: EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Directive

rules.regulation_name: EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Directive
rules.requirement: Publish an annual human-rights and environmental due-diligence narrative covering tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers.

rules.regulation_name: EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Directive
rules.requirement: ISO 14001 (or equivalent) environmental management certification covering all production sites.

rules.regulation_name: EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Directive
rules.requirement: SA8000 (or equivalent) social accountability certification, current and valid.

rules.regulation_name: EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Directive
rules.requirement: Lead content in dyes must not exceed 90 ppm per EU REACH alignment.

rules.regulation_name: EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Directive
rules.requirement: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class I (infant/baby textiles) requires lead-in-dye levels at or below 25 ppm for product lines shipped to retailers carrying infant categories.
